name: GDEX Trading
description: Official MCP server for GDEX (gdex.pro), Gemach DAO's multi-chain trading terminal: spot swaps on Solana, Sui and 10 EVM chains, Hyperliquid perps including HIP-3 equity, FX and commodity markets, limit orders, copy trading, cross-chain bridging, portfolio and token discovery (117 tools: 109 execution, 8 documentation).
author: GemachDAO

GDEX_API_KEY.description: GDEX API key; the server auto-authenticates with it on startup.

GDEX_API_URL.description: Override the GDEX API base URL (default: https://trade-api.gemach.io/v1).
